consequence.statement: Operators upgrading an environment whose CRDs are installed separately must first apply the v0.16.1 CRD bundle (kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml), verify no error occurs, and only then migrate external-secrets to v0.16.1.
consequence.remediation: Run kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml, verify no error occurs, then migrate external-secrets to v0.16.1.

original.statement: Environments upgrading to external-secrets 0.16 where the CRDs are installed separately must first apply the v0.16.1 CRD bundle (kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml), verify no error occurs, and only then migrate external-secrets to v0.16.1.

decision.reason: [ev-4139b0de79e3] is the 0.16 upgrade guide. It says that where CRDs are installed separately, "the first step you need to do is bump the crds" with the given kubectl apply of the v0.16.1 bundle, "Verify no error occurs", and only "after that" migrate external-secrets to v0.16.1. That is a mandatory operator step that must come before the upgrade, so migration-required (mandatory work) fits. The proposed statement and remediation repeat the evidence's terms without claiming a failure the evidence doesn't state. The evidence gives no severity; medium is the proposers' estimate and claims nothing the evidence contradicts.
